name: EntitySwitcher
label: Entity switcher
description: Switcher for the company, team, or account a screen is scoped to, with a logo, icon, or initials mark and levels that drill in.

props.name: items
props.description: The top level of the tree. Its shape decides the list: all leaves is one flat list, any children make it drill in.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The entity selected at first (uncontrolled). The first entity when omitted.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the id and the entity when one is picked.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the panel opens or closes.

props.name: collapsed
props.description:
The mark alone, the rest of the trigger faded out, and the panel opening
beside it rather than below: the form for a collapsed rail. The mark
never moves between the two forms. Left unset, it follows a host rail
that marks itself `data-expanded="false"` (AppSidebar's
`persistentTopSlot`).

props.name: searchThreshold
props.description: How many entities, across every level, before the search field appears.

props.name: switcherLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the trigger and the panel; the selected entity's name follows it on the trigger.

props.name: searchLabel
props.description: Placeholder and accessible name of the search field.

props.name: backLabel
props.description: The row that climbs out of a level. `{name}` is the level above.

props.name: topLevelLabel
props.description: Stands in for `{name}` in `backLabel` when the level above is the top.

props.name: wholeBranchLabel
props.description: The description of the row that picks a whole branch, leading its level. `{name}` is the branch.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Shown when a search finds nothing.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes on the root.
